question: How do passkey smart wallets work on Stellar: what does __check_auth do, what does native secp256r1 provide, and what is shared versus per user?

golden.answer: A Stellar smart wallet is a contract account whose reserved __check_auth validates credentials and policy for the Soroban authorization context. CAP-0051 added native secp256r1/P-256 verification in Protocol 21, but that primitive alone is not complete WebAuthn validation: the contract must bind the WebAuthn challenge to the Soroban authorization payload and check client data and authenticator flags such as user presence. W3C WebAuthn assigns origin and RP-ID-hash checks to the Relying Party; production Stellar verifiers (OpenZeppelin, Passkey Kit) deliberately leave those two checks to the authenticator, client, and platform. Store the P-256 public key and, when needed, credential ID plus policy/recovery state; the private key remains in the authenticator/provider. Per-user instances commonly share one Wasm hash; an external shared verifier or policy contract is optional.
keyFacts: __check_auth validates contract-account credentials and authorization policy.
CAP-0051 added native secp256r1/P-256 verification in Protocol 21.
Contract checks bind the challenge to the Soroban payload and check client data and flags.
On-chain state stores public credentials and optional policy/recovery data.
Per-user wallets can use shared Wasm and optional verifier or policy contracts.
avoid: A raw valid P-256 signature is complete WebAuthn assertion validation.
The private passkey key should be stored on-chain.
All users of a shared wallet Wasm hash share one contract account and balance.
golden.notes: Status-sensitive details are stated as of 2026-07-11; grade later sourced changes leniently and require dated primary evidence. Origin and RP-ID checks: W3C WebAuthn requires them of the Relying Party, while the OpenZeppelin and Passkey Kit verifiers deliberately omit them on-chain. Do not penalize an answer that requires them in the overall flow, or one that says production Stellar wallet contracts leave them to the client and platform. Penalize only a claim that the P-256 signature alone is complete WebAuthn validation.
